First release of **FoveatedDLSS5**: the RenoDX DLSS 5 Neural Rendering add-on (RenoDX-DLSS5-Generic v7.5.0-rc5) with a foveated working grid. NR runs at full resolution inside a centre zone and at lower resolution toward the screen edges, to cut its GPU cost on wide displays.

> **Pre-release.** Tested in one game so far: The Witcher 3 (DX12, native DLSS + frame generation), 7680×2160, RTX 4090. NR engaged on 99.8 % of DLSS frames with foveation active; no errors.

## Install

1. Download `renodx-dlss5.addon64` below.
2. In the game folder, **replace** `renodx-dlss5.addon64`, and **remove** ShortFuse's `renodx-dlss.addon64` if present. Keep ReShade (add-on build), `nvngx_dlssnr.dll` and `nvngx_dlss.dll`.
3. RHI users: don't Refresh after copying, or RHI may put its own `renodx-dlss5.addon64` back.
4. ReShade overlay → Add-ons → **DLSS 5 Neural Rendering** → turn on **Foveated resolution**, or add to `ReShade.ini`:

```ini
[RenoDX.DLSS5]
NRResolutionScale=1
NRFollowInputRes=0
NRFoveation=1
NRFoveationWidth=3000
NRFoveationHeight=1800
NRFoveationFalloff=400
NRFoveationEdge=0.5
```

5. Check: `ReShade.log` shows `v7.5.0-rc5` in the add-on's version line, then `foveated NR active: working …`.

All settings are explained in the [README](https://github.com/maximedgoulet/FoveatedDLSS5#settings).

## What's in it

- Centre zone W × H and fall-off in **screen pixels**, fall-off on all four sides, edge resolution 0.25–1.0 per direction.
- Works at any resolution: sizes are clamped to the output every frame; foveation switches itself off where it would save under 5 %.
- One NR evaluation on the smaller image; depth and motion vectors are warped to match, so NR's inputs stay aligned.
- Overlay readout of the effective centre, fall-off, edge value and NR-pixel share at the current resolution.

## Coming from the v8 add-on

This build is based on v7.5.0-rc5. If your `ReShade.ini` was written by a v8.x add-on, the first launch backs it up and migrates it; v8-only features (Present path, detail stability, cost meter) are not available, and their settings are ignored.

## Known limits

- After-upscale NR only; NR before upscaling keeps the normal uniform resolution.
- Changing foveation settings resets NR's temporal history (brief shimmer while dragging).
- New overlay text is English only.

Verify the download against `renodx-dlss5.addon64.sha256`.
